 Schools to get extended breaks in November 2026 due to Diwali, Kartik Poornima and Bhai Dhooj. (Image AI generated) AI Summary State education boards are rolling out diverse holiday calendars for November, with extended festival breaks stretching up to three weeks in regions like Gujarat and Goa, while other states opt for shorter closures around Diwali and Guru Nanak Jayanti. How will these varying schedules impact upcoming board exam preparations?
 + Follow on Google Add as preferred source School holidays in November 2026 will vary across India, with several states scheduling extended Diwali vacations and others observing individual festival holidays. The dates depend on state education department calendars and school-specific notifications, so students and parents should check the schedule applicable to their institution before making plans.
 Diwali falls on November 8, while Guru Nanak Jayanti and Kartik Purnima fall on November 24. States including Maharashtra, Goa, Chhattisgarh, Bihar and Gujarat have different holiday schedules for the month, with some announcing breaks lasting several days.
 State-wise school holidays in November 2026 
 School vacation dates will differ from one state to another. Let’s take a look at the state-wise school holiday schedules for November and find out how long students can expect their schools to remain closed.
 Goa: Diwali vacation from November 2 to 21 
 Schools in Goa are scheduled to observe their Diwali vacation from Monday, November 2, to Saturday, November 21. The break spans 20 calendar days, including weekends.
 Maharashtra: 13-day Diwali break 
 Recognised primary, secondary and higher secondary schools in Maharashtra will observe a Diwali vacation from November 2 to November 14. Classes are scheduled to resume on Monday, November 16. The break covers several festive occasions, including Dhanteras, Diwali Padwa and Bhaubij.
 Chhattisgarh: Six-day Diwali holiday 
 Schools in Chhattisgarh will remain closed from November 6 to November 11, 2026. The six-day break will apply to government, aided and private schools across the state.
 Uttar Pradesh: Festival holidays 
 In Uttar Pradesh, schools will observe holidays on November 8, 9 and 11 for festivals, followed by another holiday on November 24 for Guru Nanak Jayanti and Kartik Purnima. Students should check with their respective schools to confirm the holiday dates.
 Bihar: Festival holidays from November 7 to 17 
 The 2026 Bihar's Education Department lists a festival break from November 7 to November 17. The period includes Diwali, Chitragupt Puja, Bhai Dooj and Chhath Puja for government and government-aided schools, among others. This is followed by another holiday on November 24 for Guru Nanak Jayanti and Kartik Purnima.
 Gujarat: 21-day Diwali vacation 
 Schools in Gujarat will have a 21-day Diwali vacation from November 5 to November 25. The second term is scheduled to begin on November 26.
 Tripura: School holidays in November 
 According to the Directorate of Secondary Education, Government of Tripura, schools will observe holidays on November 9 for Diwali and November 11 for Bhai Dooj.
 Will schools be closed across India in November? 
 There is no single nationwide school holiday schedule that applies to every institution. State government schools, private schools and central schools may follow different academic calendars, while local festivals and official orders can affect closures.
 Parents and students should confirm dates through official state education department notices or their schools. Those preparing for board examinations, entrance tests or practical assessments should also check whether any academic activities are scheduled during the holiday period.
